summary: Added four long topics, each the full story of a Short in our top third by stayed to watch: McDonald's, casinos, Costco and US debt. Researched long-video thumbnails and titles, and routed two code bugs that hide five of the seven topics that qualify under the owner's rule.
why: The code offered only 2 usable long topics, under the 4 minimum. Both rest on October Shorts that leave the 30-day window by 24 Nov.

findings.title: 4-6 words of thumbnail text was the biggest breakout gap (30.6% vs 26.5%)
findings.detail: In a study of 507,478 long videos, faces, colour and brightness made no difference. Titles of 45-74 characters broke out more than ones under 30.

findings.title: winning_short still demands 1,000 views
findings.detail: The owner's 12 Nov rule is the top third by stayed to watch. This blocks the Costco, US debt and gym topics.

findings.title: too_close drops a long topic as a copy of its own Short
findings.detail: This hides the McDonald's (#1) and casino (#4) topics.

findings.title: Impressions and CTR are null for all 64 videos
findings.detail: No thumbnail or title can be judged on clicks yet. Handed to the auditor via the backlog.

changes.title: 4 topics added, 2 rejected
changes.detail: Added: McDonald's, casinos, Costco, who America owes. Rejected: savings and jewellers (their Shorts are in the bottom third by stayed).

changes.title: 6 backlog items
changes.detail: 3 bugs (adopt, high), thumbnail references (adopt), thumbnail text (experiment), title length (adopt).
